name: Tinker: Explosive Augmentation procs from Gatling Gun inside the Mechsuit (#9417)
contract: Explosive Augmentation (653237, spell_proc ProcFlags 320 = PROC_FLAG_DONE_RANGED_AUTO_ATTACK | PROC_FLAG_DONE_SPELL_RANGED_DMG_CLASS) triggers its splash explosion 653238 on ranged hits. Gatling Gun's channel (500213) fires its own ranged hit 500577 via a native SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL effect, dispatched with a triggered cast. Two independent engine gates block this: (1) Unit::TriggerAurasProcOnEvent calls SetCantProc(true) for the whole proc-evaluation pass whenever the triggering spell carries TRIGGERED_DISALLOW_PROC_EVENTS, and (2) Aura::GetProcEffectMask separately refuses to let a non-PROC_ATTR_TRIGGERED_CAN_PROC aura react to any triggered spell at all (Spell::IsTriggered(), true for any TriggerCastFlags bit) unless it is an auto-attack, kill or death event. The fix strips the first flag from the re-dispatched shot (C++) and marks 653237 PROC_ATTR_TRIGGERED_CAN_PROC (SQL) to clear the second. Scrap Shot (500549, a direct player cast outside the Mechsuit) is the control: it already procs the enchant without either change, since it carries no triggered flags at all.

steps.label: Explosive Augmentation is on the gun
CONTROL: a direct Scrap Shot (outside the Mechsuit) already procs Explosive Augmentation
DISCRIMINATING (#9417): a Gatling Gun shot inside the Mechsuit still procs Explosive Augmentation's splash onto a nearby enemy
